Subject: Something new for your next trip out
Preview: 400 lumens. 40 hours. 95 grams. The Northbay Beacon is worth a look.
Body: Hey,

It's been a while. We hope you've been getting out.

We wanted to reach back out because we just added something to the lineup that's worth knowing about — the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05).

Here's what it does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough to read trail markers and navigate technical terrain at night, though it's not engineered for deep cave or technical rope work where you'd want a dedicated caving light.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime, so it'll cover a long weekend without a recharge on lower settings.
• Charges via USB-C, which means one cable covers your phone, your battery bank, and your headlamp.
• 95 grams on your head. Light enough that you'll forget it's there.

Nothing more complicated than that. If you've been running an older light that's gotten heavy or unreliable, this is a straightforward upgrade worth considering before your next trip.

Take a look and decide for yourself.
